## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
Multiply the horizontal resolved-gradient (geometric) SGS variance term of #4802 by w = Ri₊² / (Ri₊² + Ri₀²), Ri₊ = max(N², 0) / max(2 S², ε), Ri₀ = k Ri_crit, with N² the saturated moist buoyancy gradient in every cell and S² the cached strain-rate norm. The term then acts only in air that is absolutely stable to a saturated displacement and not turbulent, where the turbulence closure cannot carry the variance.

Note: This is a temporary solution. It helps with the boundary layer and tropical RH, but the physical explanation is not entirely clear. A more physical solution may be some maximum length scale for the horizontal mixing length that depends on stability.

title: Richardson-number stability weight on the geometric SGS variance term

body:
The implicit diffusion Jacobian already had a Smagorinsky branch, but the vertical Smagorinsky–Lilly tendency was always applied explicitly, so with `implicit_diffusion: true` the solver linearized a term that was not in the implicit right-hand side. The tendency now follows `diff_mode`, the eddy viscosity is refreshed on every Newton iterate, and the fields it writes live in the autodiff Jacobians. A vertically-acting Smagorinsky closure now satisfies the implicit-diffusion configuration check, and the three checks in `check_case_consistency`, previously chained with `elseif`, are independent.

Running under `use_auto_jacobian`/`use_dense_jacobian` requires ClimaCore 0.16.3 (CliMA/ClimaCore.jl `ts/promote`), whose `Number * Tensor` return types keep `Dual` storage; the compat bound enforces this. So this will only work after ClimaCore [PR 2638](https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/pull/2638) merges.

Also: the number-density redistribution in vertical diffusion, hyperdiffusion, the viscous sponge, and the PROPHET diffusive flux looked up `ρn_icl`, a field no configuration carries; it now looks up `ρn_ice`. Four AMD precomputed fields that no tendency read are no longer allocated. 

`vapor_constraint_qtot` is documented as leaving `ρq_tot` unchanged.

Co-produced with Fable 5.1
title: Apply the vertical Smagorinsky diffusion implicitly; drop unused AMD cache

body:
New pages: LES subgrid-scale closures (Smagorinsky-Lilly, anisotropic minimum dissipation, constant horizontal diffusion) and forcings and idealized cases (subsidence, large-scale advection, column Coriolis, the composed external-forcing terms and nudging, Held-Suarez, prescribed flow). 

Rewritten: topography (elevation sources, smoothing rule, linear and SLEVE warps as implemented, what sloped coordinates imply for the discretization) and the global-simulations guide (resolution and timestep choice, common numerical configurations, the tested production configurations, output, scale). 

Symbol and source tables added to the microphysics and gravity-wave pages. 

No changes to source code. Best reviewed by reading the built docs.

Produced with Claude 5.1
